fact: ZamPortal, the government platform on the GSB, hosts 322 services that citizens can access and apply for online, per its director Beaton Sibulowa.
Sibulowa confirms ZamPortal has recorded over 3.7 million transactions and generated 5 billion Kwacha since its inception.
The finance ministry's ZamMobile user manual says users sign in through ZamPass, the national digital identity and authentication service, to find and apply for e-services on the ZamServices portal.
